item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 28/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An upper-air disturbance will bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea today and tomorrow. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be brighter over southern China over the weekend and early next week. Meanwhile, the broad area of low pressure over the central part of the South China Sea will bring unsettled weather to the region. The northeast monsoon will arrive at the coast of Guangdong early next week. It will be windier over the region.
